title: Ramsey number R(3,40), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_3 and no blue K_40; it shows R(3,40) > n. The best known lower bound is R(3,40) >= 305, so a colouring of K_304 is known and one of K_305 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(3,40) >= 305: Coniglio et al., arXiv:2608.18769; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed 298; read 5 Nov 2026
